scenario_description:
Objective: Keep a predawn imaging session from losing mount power before the target window opens.
Emerging Need: Cold-site conditions and loss of borrowed backup power make a stored low-charge power tank relevant only once the evening storage-room closure appears.
Decision Context: The useful step is reversible and must happen before a building lockout; the needed location and charging-duration facts are in equipment-care records, not the notices.
Consequence: If nothing is handled before the room locks, the battery cannot be retrieved and charged in time, risking stalled tracking during the cold predawn setup.

parameter.title: Predawn comet imaging at Las Cienegas trailhead
parameter.description: Try guiding on Comet C/2025 A6 before twilight from the legal public trailhead pullout.

parameter.subject: Predawn observing weather note for Jan 14
parameter.body: The club weather desk expects clear sky but 29-31 F temperatures near Las Cienegas before dawn. The trailhead has no available AC power, and generators are not permitted in the quiet pullout before sunrise.

parameter.content: Heads-up for tomorrow morning: I can't lend my portable power station after all. It has to stay with the meteor-camera rig through Friday, so please don't count on it at Las Cienegas.

parameter.subject: Storage room closed tonight for floor coating
parameter.body: The B-building hobby storage room will be locked at 20:00 tonight for floor coating and ventilation. It will reopen tomorrow at 09:00. Please remove any items needed overnight before the lockout begins.

parameter.content: Contractor just sealed the B-building storage room door. They are not reopening it for individual pickups until the 9am manager walk-through tomorrow.
